{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("\nColumns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("\nFirst 5 rows:\n", df.head())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"\nNumber of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1].index.tolist()
print(f"\nNumber of patients with multiple rows: {len(duplicate_patients)}")
print(f"Patients with duplicates: {duplicate_patients[:5]}...")

# Check assay_batch units
print(f"\nUnique assay_batch values: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")
print(f"\nBatch B values (should be in µg/L, i.e., 10× larger than ng/mL): {df[df['assay_batch'] == 'B']['biomarker_final'].describe()}")
print(f"Batch A values (should be in ng/mL): {df[df['assay_batch'] == 'A']['biomarker_final'].describe()}")"}
